papers.title: IRIS: A Visual Cortex-Inspired Framework for Analyzing Orientation Selectivity in Vision Transformers
papers.authors: Vaishnavi B Mohan, Vijayakrishna Naganoor, Yashas Annadani, Shashank Hegde
papers.affiliations: Vaishnavi B Mohan - University of Washington, USA; Vijayakrishna Naganoor - Microsoft, USA; Yashas Annadani - TU Munich, Germany; Shashank Hegde - Nvidia, USA
papers.intro: 论文提出IRIS，一套受神经科学启发的方向选择性分析框架，通过RSS、ORS、OSI和HWHM等指标系统测量ViT各层表征中的方向编码，发现预训练目标是方向选择性最强的决定因素，并据此提出一种基于机制的层解冻微调启发式方法。

papers.title: Lesion Detection in CT with Frozen Self-Distilled Features: SALT, a Spatially Adaptive Label-Guided Temperature
papers.authors: Mahmut S. Gokmen, Evan W. Damron, Mitchell A. Klusty, Caroline N. Leach, Emily B. Collier, V. K. Cody Bumgardner
papers.tags: object detection, medical image, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: University of Kentucky（前五位作者）；University of Louisville（V. K. Cody Bumgardner）
papers.intro: 本文提出SALT（Spatially Adaptive Label-guided Temperature），通过弱标签在自蒸馏预训练中空间自适应地锐化教师温度并上调病灶patch的损失权重，使得冻结的编码器特征更集中地编码病变信息，从而仅用轻量级CenterNet式检测头即可在四个CT队列上显著提升…

papers.title: HelloWorld: Enabling Socially Interactive Characters in Video World Models
papers.authors: Liangyang Ouyang, Ruicong Liu, Xuangeng Chu, Kaipeng Zhang, Yoichi Sato
papers.affiliations: The University of Tokyo, Alaya Lab
papers.intro: HelloWorld 提出了一种基于自蒸馏微调和训练时自由时间交叉注意力掩码的视频世界模型，使生成角色能够在用户按下按钮后，在指定时间窗口内面向镜头执行多种社交互动，同时保持高质量的相机轨迹跟随和画面美学。

papers.title: VQ-VAD: Vector-quantized Motion Representation Learning for Human-centric Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Narges Rashvand, Ghazal Alinezhad Noghre, Shanle Yao, Gabriel Maldonado, Hamed Tabkhi
papers.affiliations: University of North Carolina at Charlotte（北卡罗来纳大学夏洛特分校），Electrical and Computer Engineering Department
papers.intro: VQ-VAD将原本用于图像生成的VQ-GAN适配到关键点序列上，通过学习正常行为的离散运动码本，将观测序列映射到码本时的重建误差作为异常分数，实现了在域内、跨域和跨数据集三种场景下均表现优异的姿态驱动视频异常检测框架。

papers.title: Beyond Reprojection Error: Camera Calibration with 3D Targets
papers.authors: Dennis Ruppel, Hasan Kutlu, Kai A. Neumann, Martin Knuth, Pedro Santos, Andreas Weinmann, Arjan Kuijper
papers.affiliations: Fraunhofer Institute for Computer Graphics Research, Darmstadt; Technical University of Applied Sciences Würzburg-Schweinfurt（Computer Vision, Imaging and Data Analysis Group）; Technical University Darmstadt（Mathematical and Applied Visual Computing）
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种以场景射线预测为核心的相机标定框架，通过新型3D二十面体靶标和基于射线的交点误差、重建误差指标，证明了其相比传统2D平面靶标与重投影误差能带来更高的标定精度和更好的3D重建评估效果。

papers.title: A Paragraph is Worth a Thousand Captions: Rethinking Text Supervision for Vision-Language Retrieval
papers.authors: Mahyar Ghazanfari, Amin Tabrizian, Arsyi Aziz, Binshuai Wang, Peng Wei
papers.affiliations: The George Washington University
papers.intro: 通过冻结视觉编码器、仅微调文本编码器的受控实验，系统研究了从单标题到多句段落的文本监督粒度对对比图像-文本检索的影响，发现段落监督无需任何架构修改即可在长描述基准上匹配或超越Long-CLIP，并揭示了长序列利用能力的成因。

papers.title: OmniEdit-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Instruction-based Video Editing
papers.authors: Chenxuan Miao, Yutong Feng, Yi Lu, Yunfeng Yan, Donglian Qi, Shiwei Zhang, Yu Liu, Xi Chen, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong; Wan Team, Alibaba Group; Zhejiang University; Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出了一个覆盖空间、时间、音频、参考和推理五个轨道的综合指令视频编辑基准 OmniEdit-Bench，并引入以准确性为前提的评分机制，实现对编辑质量的更可靠评估。

papers.title: Promptable Animal Pose Tracking Across Species
papers.authors: Le Li, Daniela Ivanova, Nicolas Pugeault
papers.affiliations: School of Computing Science, University of Glasgow
papers.intro: 本文提出一个基于视觉基础模型的“可提示”动物姿态跟踪框架，用户只需在单个参考帧中标注关键点，即可通过监督或无监督两条路径在视频序列中跨帧跟踪这些关键点，在跟踪精度与跨物种泛化之间取得平衡。

papers.title: "Allow" to Achieve, Over-Privileged Inadvertently: The Unintended Cost of Task-Completion-Driven Pop-up Decisions in Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Dongsheng Chen, Yuxuan Li, Guanhua Chen, Jiaxin Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao, Lei Ma, Xin Yao, Xuetao Wei
papers.affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology（南方科技大学）；City University of Hong Kong（香港城市大学）；The University of Tokyo（东京大学）；Lingnan University（岭南大学）
papers.intro: 本文通过在AndroidLab真实任务中注入Android风格权限弹窗，系统评估了四个前沿多模态大语言模型驱动的移动GUI智能体的"权限素养"，发现它们存在任务条件化的应用信任偏见（App-Trust Bias）、任务优先覆盖（Task-Prior Override）以及提示词缓解手段的不稳定性，并…

papers.title: LoginTrap: Uncovering Task-Agnostic Phishing-Style Indirect Prompt Injection Attacks against LLM-based Web Agents
papers.authors: Longtao Guo, Zelin Zhang, Kaifeng Huang, Yang Shi
papers.affiliations: Tongji University（同济大学）
papers.intro: 论文提出LoginTrap，一种任务无关的登录诱导型间接提示注入攻击方法，仅通过控制网页上下文和受控登录流程，即可在黑盒条件下诱导LLM-based web agents进入登录流程并泄露敏感信息，平均端到端攻击成功率达86%。

papers.title: The First EgoCross Challenge at EgoVis 2026: Cross-Domain Egocentric Video Question Answering
papers.authors: Yuqian Fu, Tianwen Qian, Yanjun Li, Yu Li, Kunyu Peng, Xu Zheng, Yongqin Xian, Alessio Tonioni, Yanwei Fu, Xiaoling Wang, Danda Paudel, Federico Tombari, Luc Van Gool, Leyi Wu, Yifan Zhao, Jinjie Zhang, Yinchuan Li, Yingcong Chen, Zixu Li, Zhiwei Chen, Zhiheng Fu, Wenbo Wang, Yupeng Hu, Weili Guan, Liqiang Nie, Takuya Murakawa, Toru Tamaki, Yi Wen, Zhenglin Du, Zhengyang Li, Lingling Li, Licheng Jiao, Wenping Ma
papers.tags: visual question answering, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: 未明确（论文注明全部作者的团队名称与机构信息在附录A中给出；通讯作者Yuqian Fu所属机构为King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, KAUST）
papers.intro: 本文介绍了在CVPR 2026第三届EgoVis Workshop上举办的首届EgoCross挑战赛——一个覆盖手术、工业、极限运动和动物视角四个非日常领域的跨域第一人称视频问答竞赛，详细报告了赛制设计、基线性能、排行榜结果与获奖方案，并公开了所有数据、基线和代码资源。

papers.title: FocusMem: Factorizing Content, Readout, and Trust in Latent GUI Memory
papers.authors: Zhuoran Zhang, Bowen Li, Jingcheng Ju, Yang Shi, Qixun Wang, Haotian Wang, Wei Chen, Tengjiao Wang
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science, Peking University; Key Lab of High Confidence Software Technologies, Peking University; Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: FocusMem提出了一种分解的潜在GUI记忆接口，通过角色感知内容基础、状态条件读取和块级信任门控，将记忆的内容形成、决策相关性和证据可信性解耦，在保持GUI策略冻结的情况下显著提升了五个GUI基准上的任务成功率。

papers.title: REZE: Recognition-Based Zero-Shot Extraction for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.authors: Boyang Li, Chenhui Gou, Jianfei Cai
papers.affiliations: Department of Data Science and AI, Monash University
papers.intro: REZE提出一种无需训练的零样本视频时间接地方法，将视频分割为短片段并用冻结的VLM逐片段打分，再通过外部确定性聚合算法将分数序列转换为单区间、多区间或高亮点检测结果，从而解耦识别与时间聚合，在多个基准上刷新了训练-free方法的SOTA。

papers.title: Predict, Then Retrieve: Cross-Instance Future-State Retrieval from Video Prefixes
papers.authors: Quynh Vo, Thong Nguyen, Vinh-Hien Do, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Anh-Tuan Luu
papers.affiliations: Centre for AI Research, VinUniversity; National University of Singapore（第一页同时列出两机构，作者具体归属未逐人标明）
papers.intro: 本文提出 Predictive State Retrieval (PSR) 任务和基准，并给出一个轻量级冻结编码器检索器 LFTR，通过天花板分解证明“预测未来状态”是核心可学习瓶颈，而“感知/检索”本身已接近可解。

papers.title: Perception Before Reasoning: Dynamic Latent Reasoning for Video Understanding and Question Answering
papers.authors: Haotian Xia, Zilin Xiao, Junbo Zou, Vicente Ordonez, Hanjie Chen
papers.affiliations: 1Department of Computer Science, Rice University; 2College of Sciences, Georgia Institute of Technology
papers.intro: DyLaR 提出一种“先感知、后按需推理”的潜在推理框架，将视频问答建模为“感知潜在变量（perception latents）进行视觉证据 grounding，再自适应决定是否追加推理潜在变量（reasoning latents）”的动态潜在响应，以不到20个token的生成长度在多个视频问答基准…

papers.title: Geo-Embed: Towards Unified Multimodal Embeddings for Urban Understanding
papers.authors: Jiapeng Li, Yong Li, Junjie Zhou, Fan Zhang, Yu Liu
papers.affiliations: 北京大学；北京邮电大学
papers.intro: 本文构建了面向城市理解的大规模多模态嵌入基准GeoMEB，并提出Geo-Embed统一嵌入模型，将异构地理空间查询-目标匹配统一为指令条件下的排序任务，在GeoMEB上相对最强基线取得15.3%的总体平均提升。

papers.title: TDVR: Joint Text Disambiguation and Viewpoint Reasoning for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
papers.authors: Qingxi Du, Junbo Wang, Yuke Li, Yining Zhu
papers.tags: point cloud, scene understanding, multimodal learning, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University（西北工业大学）
papers.intro: 论文提出TDVR，一个无需训练、基于多模态大模型的零样本3D视觉定位框架，通过联合文本消歧与视角推理，在ScanRefer和Sr3D数据集上显著超越现有零样本方法，甚至在部分指标上超过若干全监督方法。

papers.title: MissClick: Exploiting Digit-Serialized Coordinates to Attack GUI Grounding Models
papers.authors: Yu Ran, Wentao Zhao, Xin Zhang, Yi Pan
papers.affiliations: National University of Defense Technology
papers.intro: 论文提出MissClick，一种利用GUI定位模型坐标输出中数字序列的十进制位权结构、针对无目标和有目标攻击分别设计不同目标函数的白盒对抗攻击方法，显著提升了攻击成功率。

papers.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
papers.authors: Maximilian Dillitzer, Tin Stribor Sohn, Jason J. Corso, Michael Auerbach
papers.affiliations: University of Applied Science Esslingen; Karlsruhe Institute of Technology; Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG; University of Michigan
papers.intro: 本文通过系统实证研究，发现LLM和VLM对字母大小写具有类似于人类视觉显著性的内在注意力调制属性，大小写格式可作为零样本注意力引导机制，但注意力集中并不总是提升任务性能，且推理模型的思考阶段会缓冲这种表面形式的影响。

papers.title: MultiCompose: Multi-Concept Personalized Composition with Per-Subject Attribute Binding
papers.authors: Ruirui Zhang, Zhengkai Zhao, Pan Gao
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics（南京航空航天大学）
papers.intro: MultiCompose提出了一种无需联合训练的多主体个性化组合框架，通过语义保持正则化和两阶段推理（预融合+融合）实现逐主体属性绑定，并引入MSP-Bench基准联合评估身份保真度、属性绑定准确性和属性错位。
